findings.quoted_finding: rhat/ess defaults call as.matrix on draws_array, collapsing four chains into one before splitting
defect_evidence: The candidate passes a draws_array of shape 2000x4x1 to scalar diagnostic defaults. The independent probe observes coercion to 8000x1, followed by splitting into 4000x2, instead of splitting the four original chains into 1000x8.
All candidate diagnostics match the incorrectly pooled path. For N.iota.s, the correct four-chain Rhat is 1.00120757086769, versus 1.00020832622997 in the candidate.
mechanical_checks: Coordinator opened the frozen postprocessor lines 87-91 and the independent shape counterexample JSON/CSV.
Candidate identity audit verified all 321 declared files and current G2 approval before this adjudication.
Independent QA recomputed diagnostics from the saved raw chains; no new sampling.
findings.reasoning: The criterion requires rank-normalized split diagnostics of four independent chains. Pooling them before splitting changes that statistic and can conceal between-chain disagreement. This defect is separate from tail-ESS NA caused by discrete atoms; preserving the correct shape does not authorize relaxing the latter criterion.
findings.disposition: Pass an ordinary iterations-by-chain numeric matrix directly to posterior::rhat, ess_bulk and ess_tail; assert dimensions. Recompute solely from the unchanged revision2 RDS into revision3. Add an adversarial deterministic chain-shape regression check; preserve all prior candidates and code snapshots.

reasons: The failure has an independently reproduced numeric counterexample and a bounded code repair already within the authorized G3 task.
No model change, new MCMC, new seed, tolerance change or G3 approval is authorized by this record.
